findings.where: M21 claim_en and claim_zh; section.md, C's role bullet (both languages). Item 2.
findings.quote: and in a ranking of courses, in general, only under C (07 §4) / 在进程的排序中，一般只依于 C（07 §4）
findings.problem: Yes, 'only under C' is too strong. 07 §4 has two statements. A ranking needs C or a premise in its place, which is a necessary condition with an alternative. C gives order, in general alone, which says which of the two premises orders. M21 turns the second into a necessity and drops the alternative. 'In general' does not repair this, because the exception it carries (self-concern) is only one case of a premise standing in. The same chapter names a weaker premise that orders widenings. This is a new form of the overstatement GC4 exists to remove. The section's 'what rests on C, in general, is a ranking of courses' inherits it, although the same bullet quotes 'C or a premise in its place' correctly.
findings.evidence: pf3-crux:theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md:232 'A ranking of courses needs C or a premise in its place: C gives order, in general alone'. 07 §4.4 'Monotonicity at the standpoint is C's premise relocated: weaker, still a premise', with `Weighting.widens_iff_every_of_class`. GLOSSARY.md:62 says 'gives order', not 'only under'.
findings.fix: Use 07's first clause and drop the hedge. EN: 'and in a ranking of courses under C or a premise in its place (07 §4)'. ZH: '在进程的排序中，须有 C 或代替它的前提（07 §4）'. Section EN: 'and what needs C or a premise in its place is a ranking of courses'. Section ZH: '须有 C 或代替它的前提的，是进程的排序'. This also answers the recheck's objection that 'in general' names a case M21 is not about.

findings.where: M21 claim_en and claim_zh; section.md, C's role bullet (both languages). Item 2.
findings.quote: as a reason with a supplied articulation and correspondence (07 §3.2) / 作为理由，须有所给的表述与对应（07 §3.2）
findings.problem: The reason's premise list is incomplete. Living significance is a hypothesis of every reason in 07 §3.2, and the record calls it an explicit normative premise. As written, an articulation and correspondence read as sufficient, so the reason reads as resting on nothing unasserted. The entry's opening clause names living significance only as what consciousness differentiates, not as this reason's premise. The section's 'comes with a supplied articulation and correspondence and uses no C' has the same gap.
findings.evidence: 07 §3.2 'Conditional (living significance, correspondence E; a supplied articulation for the reason)'. 07:232 'under it living significance follows, the reasons of §3.2 only with A or D and correspondence'. records/positive-ground-open-futures.md, Conditions 'Living significance (LivingSignificance) is an explicit normative premise', and law 3 'Under living significance'.
findings.fix: EN: 'as a reason under living significance with a supplied articulation and correspondence (07 §3.2)'. ZH: '作为理由，须有存活之意义、所给的表述与对应（07 §3.2）'. Add the same words to the section's sentence in both languages.

findings.quote: 在当时所取的 G0 路线下，明确 G0 取代了旧无前提受阻审计，未执行 blocked 更新；
findings.problem: The revision to active voice introduced two faults. (a) 明确 can now be read as a verb: 'it is made clear that G0 superseded the old audit'. The old 由明确 G0 方向取代 forced the attributive reading. (b) After the comma, 明确 G0 is the default subject of 未执行 blocked 更新, so G0 appears not to have executed an update. In the old text the topic was the audit, and the English separates the clauses with a semicolon. The route wording and the past tense are right and match the English.
findings.evidence: Whole field read in chain.copy.json. Before: '旧无前提受阻审计已由明确 G0 方向取代，未执行 blocked 更新'. EN: 'explicit G0 superseded the earlier premise-free impasse audit; no blocked update was executed.'
findings.fix: '在当时所取的 G0 路线下，明确的 G0 取代了旧无前提受阻审计；未执行 blocked 更新；新的实践判断候选…'. M25's zh has the same 明确G0/J form after its new opening; I did not read M25 further.
